notes: Company profile: mid-market billing SaaS (subscription lifecycle + dunning + invoicing). Heavily integrated with Stripe for majority of customers; some enterprise customers on Zuora.
Primary ask: embed chat-first support agent for billing conversations (status of invoices, refunds, plan changes) with deterministic, structured outputs (JSON) that map to internal ticketing flow.
Latency SLO: p95 end-to-end streaming <~250-300ms for 8-12 token bursts; must support server-sent events streaming to client UI.

Tooling: function-calling / tool hooks mandatory — agent must call Stripe / Zuora via Redwood function interface; expect 2-way confirmations and structured response schema (action, payload, confidence).
Quality & safety: need guardrails for billing actions (explicit user confirmation step before issuing refunds). Audit logging and signed event traces required for compliance.

Deployment path: start on Hosted API for POC and fast iteration; if sustained latency and cost goals met, move to Dedicated reserved capacity (monthly commit). They also want a Private/VPC option eventually for enterprise customers.

Quote from product lead: "We need predictable latency for live agents — buffering and slow token generation kills UX. If Redwood can hit <300ms p95 with streaming and structured JSON for actions, we can justify a committed contract."
Cost sensitivity: high for token-heavy workflows (long context + many agents). Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching) to reduce unit cost.
Security notes: require SSO (SAML/Okta), KMS integration for keys, opt-in data residency for EU customer tenants; retention controls for transcripts (90 days default, extendable).
Integration notes: developer team uses Node + TypeScript; asked for examples of function-calling SDK patterns and streaming SDK examples (Server-Sent Events & WebSocket).
Potential upsell: Dedicated for predictable throughput; Redwood Console retention add-on for longer audit windows; private deployment for enterprise accounts with EU residency requirement.
